titles.romaji: Mob Psycho 100: Daiikkai Rei toka Soudansho Ian Ryokou - Kokoro Mitasu Iyashi no Tabi
titles.english: Mob Psycho 100 II: The First Spirits and Such Company Trip ~A Journey that Mends the Heart and Heals the Soul~
titles.native: モブサイコ100 第一回霊とか相談所慰安旅行~ココロ満たす癒やしの旅~

description:
Mob, Reigen, Dimple, and Serizawa, the newest member of the Spirits and Such Consultation Office staff, take a trip up to a secluded hot spring in Zebra Prefecture. Reigen received a request to discover the truth behind strange rumors about the inn.

(Source: Funimation)

Note: The OVA was screened at an anime event that took place at Kasukabe Citizens Cultural Center in Saitama Prefecture on July 7th, 2019.
